tbesh_subentries.definition_html: This name means soothsaying or augury

tbesh_html: This name means soothsaying or augury

strongs_1890.strongs_def: figuratively, to act covertly, i.e. practise magic
strongs_1890.derivation: a primitive root; to cover; used only as a denominative from H6051 (עָנָן), to cloud over;
strongs_1890.kjv_def: [idiom] bring, enchanter, Meonemin, observe(-r of) times, soothsayer, sorcerer.
